steps.title: Web service - Domains and TLS
steps.subtitle: Passwords travel in sign-in requests: give the client an https:// sync_address.

steps.title: Web service - Upstream
steps.subtitle: Atuin's sync server listens on port 8888; keep that port off the public network.

steps.title: Web service - Error messages
steps.subtitle: Pass Atuin's own JSON errors through so the client can print them.

steps.title: HTTP - Sync requests
steps.subtitle: Atuin refuses bodies above 2 MiB itself; the 100-record upload pages reach 160 KB.

steps.title: HTTP - Sync request rate
steps.subtitle: Per-path limits sized to the client's upload and parallel download pages.

steps.title: HTTP - Parallel downloads
steps.subtitle: One client downloads over 8 connections; the default of 10 per address allows one.

steps.title: Security - Only Atuin clients (optional)
steps.subtitle: Set yes and GREYLIST_USER_AGENT=^atuin/ to refuse other user agents (spoofable).

steps.title: Security - Review CRS exclusions
steps.subtitle: Ciphertext and password fields on five exact routes skip the injection rules.
